verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document programmatic wallet issuance for agents, scoped agent keys, policy controls, or limits on what an agent can move. Machine payments (agents paying for APIs), business-level stablecoin Financial Accounts and the MCP server are adjacent features, not agent wallet custody with guardrails.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can hold and use wallets safely — programmatic wallet issuance for agents with scoped keys, policy controls, and documented limits on what an agent can move
